<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw"
                  name="Chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChainsawProperties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback on first chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Provides chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Sends production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides at least five chainsaw properties, including guide-bar length, chain width, and electric or motor type">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_ChainsawProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive ordered parts"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce first chainsaw and send updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirst" name="Assemble parts for the first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstSaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer responds about the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" name="Customer likes the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotLiked"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainder" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates to the customer during production" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="true">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RemainderProduced" name="Rest of order produced"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RemainderNotProduced" name="Rest of order not produced"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdatesComplete" name="Production updates complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirst" targetRef="Task_SendFirstSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstSaw" targetRef="Event_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Liked" name="Likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLiked" name="Does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikesSaw" targetRef="EndEvent_RemainderNotProduced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainder" targetRef="EndEvent_RemainderProduced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdatesComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
